title: Module 6 Quiz: Future of AI in Finance

questions.text: Which statement best describes Agentic AI as discussed in the lesson?
options: Agentic AI can only respond to user queries with pre-written scripts.
Agentic AI performs multi-step tasks on its own while staying within defined limits.
Agentic AI requires constant human input for each step of a process.
Agentic AI is limited to providing generic monthly budget advice.
questions.explanation: Agentic AI autonomously carries out multi-step tasks within set boundaries.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT identified as an enduring human skill in an AI economy?
options: Ability to ask the right questions of AI tools and interpret outputs.
Capacity to feel and manage emotions in social interactions.
Skill to generate high-frequency trading algorithms without oversight.
Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new tools.
questions.explanation: Generating trading algorithms without oversight is not listed as an enduring human skill; ethical judgment requires human review.

questions.text: Before sharing your transaction data with an AI tool, you should verify that its privacy policy clearly explains encryption, storage, and any third-party sharing.
questions.explanation: The habit advises checking the policy for those specifics and proceeding only if clear.

questions.text: AI regulation in finance is designed to create strict safeguards that protect data, prevent bias, and ensure transparency of automated transfers.
questions.explanation: The lesson states regulation sets guardrails for data protection, bias prevention, and auditability.
